fact: DLA Piper states that the Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 24 of 2023) came into force on 22 December 2023 and permits transfer of personal data outside Seychelles provided the transfer ensures an adequate level of protection, with appropriate safeguards or legal mechanisms.

The Commission received and handled 14 cases under the Act in 2025 (6 data transfers, 5 breaches, 2 refused deletion requests, 1 consultation), described as guidance, assessment and corrective advice, with no decision or sanction on a named controller and no count of cases settled.

The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 shows Seychelles (no. 43) with no date of signature, ratification/accession or deposit for the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection.
